verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents an API reference at /api and publishes an official Postman collection that 'lets you call the API without writing code.' Users import it, add API keys, and edit sample data, and test keys let calls run in the sandbox. These runnable examples sit in an external Postman collection, though; nothing shows an interactive try-it console inside the reference itself, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. Missing for 10: an in-docs interactive explorer with runnable request examples, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
